programme.title: Humko Tumse Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: A blind girl loses her lover just when she regains her sight and meets another man who falls in love with her. She accepts his proposal, but around the same time, her former lover returns.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: The sanctity of a happy nuclear family is tested when the man of the house brings home his illegitimate nine-year-old son from a brief fling. His devastated wife grapples to accept her reality as the naïve child begins to soften her heart.

programme.title: Ek Hi Raasta
programme.desc: A terrorist aspiring to rule over India needs vital information about Indian armed forces. He recruits an Indian army officer for this purpose, who goes to great evil lengths to get the treasured information.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.

programme.title: Mann
programme.desc: Dev and Priya meet on a cruise ship and fall head over heels in love. They decide to sort out their previous betrothals and careers, and meet six months later. However, when Priya does not keep her end of the bargain, Dev is left heartbroken.

programme.title: Jaali Note
programme.desc: Inspector Dinesh (Dev Anand) is assigned to stop the recent flood of counterfeit currency notes in Mumbai. He goes undercover and assumes the identity of a thief in order to infiltrate a gang. In the course of his investigation, where he is hobnobbing with criminals, he becomes romantically involved with a female reporter and makes a discovery of shocking personal significance.

programme.title: Bhumika (The Role)
programme.desc: Usha is exploited by her self-seeking husband Keshav Dalvi who wants to thrive on her talent by managing her career. When she gets a sense of what he is up to, she looks for a better life partner.

programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend’s house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.
